title: cinnagrostis lagurus
intro: Cinnagrostis lagurus, commonly known as Common Broom, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting respiratory function. The health benefits of Cinnagrostis lagurus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
